dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: If this place does indeed become a market, then we should establish connections with the Feiyun Commerce Guild as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Market?

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: That's right, I've heard people say that The Chasm is about to be bought over by the Yanshang Teahouse and turned into a grand market.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: I'm not overstating things, either. A couple of days earlier, I came across some people from Yanshang Teahouse who'd come looking for Muning the manager.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: So, just by chance, I heard them discussing some kind of monetary transaction.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: How did it go again...? Let me think.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: "Thanks to the second young master of the Feiyun Commerce Guild, I was able to raise this sum of Mora. And I would also like to thank you representatives of the Yanshang Teahouse for making a trip down to this quiet spot specifically."

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: I mean, just listen to that. They must mean that Muning's been in contact with Yanshang Teahouse to liven this place up in collaboration with the Feiyun Commerce Guild, am I right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Feiyun Commerce Guild?

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: Exactly! I've heard that they usually deal in silks and satins, but I didn't expect them to also want in on that Chasm Mora as well.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: Also, I never expected Muning to have monetary connections to the Feiyun Commerce Guild. This is a great opportunity!

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: So, uh... could you tell me a bit about the details behind their development plans?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: Oh... Alright then, I'll ponder this a bit longer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think that's how things are.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: Oh, come on. These business discussions aren't what they seem on the surface. Much thought is needed to decipher their plots and plans!

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: I'll ponder this a while longer. I won't let this opportunity slip by.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you asking me?

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: Well, that's because you've contributed so much to resolving the situation down below! I'm sure they'll tell you everything.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: If even you've never heard a peep about this, then surely there is some super-secret plan at play. That means that it's all the more imperative that I do not miss a thing!
